limitations: Binance spot history remains a proxy for X-Perp execution.
Tree probabilities are empirical scores, not calibrated guarantees.
Five-minute MTM drawdown cannot observe sub-candle excursions, but literal stop-first exits bound them at the configured stop unless a gap occurs.
Gross results exclude fees at user request.

protocol.candidate_space: both LONG and SHORT at every hourly state
protocol.drawdown: five-minute marked equity across all concurrent positions; entry size follows realized equity used by account replay
protocol.entry: next five-minute market open after closed hourly state
